title: Interrupt deep-dive
ev: USER: "Hey Jarvis, clear Thursday for the board." - Google Calendar open
USER: "Move everything, and tell everyone."
JARVIS: "Moving six meetings, and telling-" - agents panel: Tell 14 guests, Post in #leadership
USER interrupts Jarvis: "Wait, not Friday. I am off Friday."
JARVIS: "Got it. Wednesday instead." - Thursday column greys out as board prep
JARVIS: "Everyone is told." - 14 guests told, posted in #leadership
USER starts a new task: "Now open Lin-"
PROACTIVE INTERRUPTION: Jarvis cuts in: "Sorry to interrupt."
Banner shell drops from the top
Banner fills: Lumen Health is about to churn - AT RISK chip
JARVIS: "Lumen Health is about to churn."
Evidence rows stream in: "Their tickets tripled," (Support tickets up 3x)
"they cut 18 seats," - row 2
"and their champion just left." - Priya changed jobs; Brain cites 4 signals
Suggested action button: Run the save plan
USER: "Save the account." - banner collapses into 3 agent tasks
Agents: Email Lumen CFO, Book the save call, Two months free (Stripe)
JARVIS: "Done. I emailed their CFO from you,"
"booked a call for Wednesday, and gave them two months free." - Credit applied $10,867
USER resumes: "Okay, now open Linear."
USER: "Take care of the list." - Linear My issues
JARVIS: "On it. 6 agents." - 6 ARC tasks run in the panel
USER: "Meanwhile, build the board deck." - Keynote: Q3 at a glance
JARVIS: "Deck is ready."
USER: "Send the deck to the team." - Gmail compose
USER interrupts again: "Wait, just Dana."
JARVIS: "Only Dana. Sent." - Deck sent to Dana card
USER: "Thanks." JARVIS: "Anytime."
